explication: WebCodex lets AI clients operate on repositories and development tools on user-owned machines. The main workflow is client request → Server routing and authorization → Runner execution against a local project → observable job results for review. Desktop and CLI support setup and administration; additional capabilities include project management, browser/computer control, workflow sessions, and audit evidence. The README documents the overall flow, but the sampled source is partial, so internal Server routing links are limited to relationships explicitly supported by the available evidence.
